title: Per-item database or network calls
summary: Issuing database or HTTP calls inside collection loops instead of batching or joining.
rationale: Per-item remote calls create N+1 behavior and multiply latency, cost, and carbon.

detection.notes: Detect reqwest/sqlx/diesel calls inside loops over records or IDs.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Batch requests, prefetch associations, use joins, or apply concurrency limits with backpressure.
remediation.tradeoffs: Batching can complicate error handling and partial retries.
